reference.title: Scenario 6: Image with caption
reference.shortdesc: Consider a markdown image followed by descriptive text that serves as a caption.

section.p: Consider a markdown image followed by descriptive text that serves as a caption.

entry.codeblock: ![Alarm Configuration Screen](images/alarm-config.png) Figure 1. Alarm Configuration screen showing notification settings.
<fig> <title>Figure 1. Alarm Configuration screen showing notification settings.</title> <image href="media/alarm-config.png"> <alt>Alarm Configuration Screen</alt> </image> </fig>

section.p: Result: The converter identifies the text immediately following the image as a caption and generates a DITA <fig> element containing a <title> and an <image>. The image alt text is preserved from the markdown image description.
